info.name: Earth API — Developer Collection
info.description: Importable request templates for the live Earth API service, maintained by the Earth API operator with AI assistance. The collection uses only https://api.earth.icu/v1. The public product, documentation, console entry, model catalog, and pricing rows were rechecked on 1 October 2026. Verify your authenticated catalog, account access, balance, and current prices before testing. Generation is disabled until runGeneration is exactly YES; built-in search examples also require enableWebSearch to be exactly YES. The gateway may retry one eligible transient failure before any public output begins, but it does not replay after output starts. Do not add immediate client retry loops until you understand the response and Usage record. Do not store production keys, private prompts, personal data, or billing details in a shared collection. No request runs automatically.
